notes: The input is the bytes of the status document of the family chat. The generator writes it to <root>/families/chat/status.json and gives the reader that root.
value is the sandbox the terminal door attaches to. refusal holds the exit code name and the message. <root> in a message stands for the root directory.
This reader asks the real clock. A written_at in the year 2999 is never stale, and one in the year 2020 is always stale.
